acceptance.must_be_lighter: Measured installed filesystem reduction and improved settled base memory headroom; no hardware/functionality trade.
acceptance.comparison: Stock compatibility reference; full-source vs Zero baseline for footprint/base-stack, then Zero baseline/ethernet/cpu/combined for policy. Common versions, clients/audio and original policies matched.
acceptance.energy_gate: Promote an extra policy only with validated battery-side energy or controlled usable-runtime benefit versus Zero baseline, beyond uncertainty and within declared per-condition performance/regression limits. Test planned combination after isolated function/performance passes even if standalone energy is inconclusive. Compare selected Zero to matched full-source for the total image claim. USB screening cannot promote; a baseline release can fulfill the image battery goal only if its own full-source battery comparison passes.
acceptance.installation_test_isolation: Both base packages build in existing ARM64 builder; install/remove/upgrade tests in isolated root with services blocked/no host buses/devices or sysfs tuning; boot tests disposable/spare-card only.
acceptance.proof_boundary: Headless Lima/chroot does not certify VT/seat/framebuffer or hardware; release requires spare-card Z4.
acceptance.usb_input_method: External input meter only after charging terminates and settles, with battery flow monitored; proves only the measured USB-powered conditions.
acceptance.battery_claim_gate: Both promotion and battery/runtime claims require validated unplugged batteryenergy or controlled usable-runtime comparisons with equal useful work/availability and unchanged safe endpoints.
acceptance.gauge_policy: Preserve raw values; TI mW/cW conflict is a conversion hypothesis, not automatic x10 calibration. Gauge fix not required for independent external-meter qualification.
acceptance.maintenance: Keep existing automaticsecurity until qualification; nonurgentdeferral only with finite perjob contract and verified retry/freshness. Test realmaintenance in longer representative runs aswell as aligned shorttrials.
acceptance.workload_mismatch: Label comparisons whole-product if clients/settings/audio/work sequence cannot be matched.
acceptance.release_fallback: If no extra policy qualifies, retain lighter baseline with no extra-policy savings claim; its own validated benefit versus matched full-source may meet the image battery objective. Without that benefit the objective remains open.
acceptance.comparison_endpoints: Idle over equal elapsedtime; bursts over equal completedwork and fixed work/return-to-idle cycle; runtime at equivalent useful start/shutdown conditions. Percentage endpoints alone do not prove energy benefit.
battery_matching: same safe shutdown thresholds; no calibration change
acceptance.observer: No charging/back-power/USBwake from instrument; record burden; quiet SSH, identical buffered cadence and brief profiling outsideenergywindows wherepossible.
acceptance.boot_accounting: Separate one-time provisioning/OOBE and its reboot from ordinary configured cold boots; controls and candidates must be equally configured.

input_evidence.usb_result: About 8000 USB IRQ occurrences/s to zero in both auto phases; leaf/hub/root suspended; restored on in control phases.
input_evidence.cpu_result: 1GHz residency about79% to6% in both isolated factor1 phases, same governor and limits.

unchanged_controls.native_clients: Same exact packages/settings; application power optimization excluded

power_strategy.package_installation: Files/configuration only; no host sysfs writes, udev triggers or live tuning in maintainer scripts. Build in existing ARM64 builder; install tests isolated.

cpu_persistence.inactive_template: Package-owned resource; not an automatically applied tmpfiles file
cpu_persistence.method: Early bounded eligibility helper validates board/kernel/BSP/distribution and CPU policy before exposing same-basename runtime override; preserve vendor entries and change only factor.
cpu_persistence.ordering: Eligibility must precede the tmpfiles application for CPU policy and every event-triggered optimized write; failed eligibility/baseline exposes no candidate override.
cpu_persistence.administrator_override: Detect higher-priority /etc override and mark unqualified; do not replace it.
cpu_persistence.qualification: Prove ordering, missing/late policies, reboot and policy recreation; bounded event-triggered reapply only if needed and revalidated.
cpu_persistence.post_activation_invalidation: On failed revalidation invalidate generation/remove owned runtime override before future application; serialize supported apply/update/preset paths. File deletion cannot stop already-open reader; generation/order checks plus readback are mandatory. Restore validated affected controls or controlled baseline boot; no baseline certification until verified.

ethernet_persistence.match: Verify integrated board/topology, USB IDs and bound interface across re-enumeration/mode changes; not bus-number or VID:PID alone.
ethernet_persistence.wakeup_limitation: Research exposed no readable leaf power/wakeup attribute; automatic cable insertion wake remains unproven.

power_strategy.activation: Event-driven configuration/bounded oneshots; no periodic tuning daemon. Coalesce duplicate events, bound boot/apply/reapply work and rate-limit diagnostics; include machinery and any continuing process/wakeups in battery accounting.
power_strategy.rollback: Remove only owned override/rule; restore affected original live controls and verify future boot policy after reboot; removing files alone is insufficient.
power_strategy.unknown_identity: Reject before any optimized write or override exposure; retain vendor configuration with a diagnostic and no optimized/hardware-qualified certification.
power_strategy.capture: Preset, original/target values, distribution/kernel/BSP identities, matching rules and generated config hashes bound into profile/input/output/resume identity.

comparison_matrix.role: Compatibility and recovery reference; not causal footprint/power control
Matched common package versions/clients and baseline policies; desktop/base-stack comparison against Zero baseline

power_strategy.build_economy: One coherent Zero APT closure/frozen rootfs; initial spare-card policy trials capture hashes/effective settings without four full builds. Final shipping preset requires a fresh immutable image job.
power_strategy.release_selection: Promote an extra policy only with validated battery-side energy or controlled usable-runtime benefit versus Zero baseline, beyond uncertainty and within declared per-condition performance/regression limits. Test planned combination after isolated function/performance passes even if standalone energy is inconclusive. Compare selected Zero to matched full-source for the total image claim. USB screening cannot promote; a baseline release can fulfill the image battery goal only if its own full-source battery comparison passes.

conditional_parameter_search.trigger: Only if first candidate fails/has unresolved battery energy, latency or resume-churn result; preregister limited alternatives, change one parameter, and stop once resolved.
conditional_parameter_search.selection: Battery benefit with performance and per-condition regression limits, never minimum clock residency.
conditional_parameter_search.identity: Initial preset matrix is not a fixed release optimum; freeze final selected parameters in contract/new image job and repeat combination qualification.

hardware_idle_return.gate: Physical devices return to appropriate baseline idle residency after legitimate consumers release resources, within declared deadlines/margins. Do not force suspend or equate PM state with rail watts.

wifi_persistence.expected: Preserve effectiveON for unset/default profiles; honor explicit userchoices.
wifi_persistence.gate: Read effective state and qualify SSH latency/reconnect; default0 alone is not proofON. Narrow owned default only if necessary/version-qualified; no new savings claim.

maintenance_qualification.inventory: Timers, sockets and D-Bus activations in finished image; actual jobs, not just installed package counts.
maintenance_qualification.unknown_power: No automatic security deferral; ConditionACPower may pass when connectors unknown.
maintenance_qualification.nonurgent_candidate: Only measured work; perjob existingdeadline, finite maxdeferral, retry trigger, manual authenticated run and freshness fallback before enabling.
tests: last successful completion versus last trigger
maintenance_qualification.scheduling: AccuracySec coalesces suitable work; RandomizedDelaySec spreads it; Persistent is not guaranteed immediate plug-in retry or completion. No pollingdaemon.
maintenance_qualification.long_session: Capture actual maintenance and180min/24h zramwriteback where present; explicitly report exposure limits and keep plugged/forced functional tests distinct from batteryenergy.

power_strategy.unchanged_controls_scope: Initial four-preset comparison; bounded follow-up parameters must be recorded separately and frozen for release.

comparison_claims.additional_policy: Candidate versus Zero baseline on battery.
comparison_claims.whole_image: Selected Zero image versus matched full-source image on battery.
comparison_claims.combined_eligibility: Isolated hardware/performance passes allow planned combined testing even when standalone battery energy is inconclusive; combination needs its own proof.
comparison_claims.baseline_fallback: No additional-policy claim; baseline can meet the whole-image battery goal if its full-source comparison passes. Otherwise that goal remains open.
